title: No Way Back
intro: You wrote something you regret. Vim will not let you walk away from unsaved changes, unless you insist.
startLines: Write anything you like on the empty line. Then try :q and read the error.
hints: :q refuses to quit when there are unsaved changes. That is the E37 error.
An exclamation mark means: I know, do it anyway.
Type :q! and press Enter to quit and throw the changes away.
